title: FBI-UAP-D003, Digital Rendering, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
doc_notes: This document is a single-page digital rendering and artistic interpretation of a 2022 UAP incident in Colorado Springs, based on a previous FBI report.

incidents.summary: A large, white, oblong object with a textured, web-like or cellular surface was observed hovering over a mountain range near a residential area.
incidents.quote: a large, white, oblong object with a textured, web-like or cellular surface hovering in a clear blue sky
